title: Session storage for the API
context: Sessions currently live in process memory, so every deploy logs everyone out. We need a shared store before the second instance goes up next week.

options.label: Redis
options.subtitle: Managed instance, TTL per key
options.recommended: Already running for the job queue, so no new infrastructure
cons: Another thing that can be down

options.label: Postgres table
options.subtitle: One `sessions` table with an expiry index

options.label: Stateless JWT
options.subtitle: Signed cookie, nothing stored server-side
cons: Cannot revoke a session before it expires

options.label: Sticky load balancing
options.subtitle: Keep memory store, pin users to an instance

options.label: Decide after the load test
options.subtitle: Ship the second instance with sticky sessions first
